name: How do I craft this again?
guessed: the build is a flat 'workbench' still life: white concrete floor divided by a black concrete line down the middle and one across the back
the two brown blocks on the left are barrels (two iron hoops and a plank lid with a rim); the back one is partly hidden
the dark block on the right is a smithing table (dark top, maroon face with grey tool marks)
the grey pile behind the smithing table is mostly hidden; filled as a stonecutter block with a diorite block on top
the exact depth of the black strips (one row back, one column centre) is estimated from the foreshortened floor
